title: holiday poll ideas that won't ruin the company

How about a "Best Homemade Holiday Recipe" poll? Users could submit family recipes and vote on their favorites. It encourages community sharing and should be legally safe as long as we steer clear of health claims or offensive ingredients.
hmm too vanilla, we need spice maybe "worst holiday gift received"? but no lawsuits

"Worst Holiday Gift Received" could work if we focus on lighthearted, humorous entries. Encourage users to share funny stories about their gifts rather than naming and shaming specific people or brands. Add disclaimers to keep it legally safe. Stick to narrative over direct criticism.
not quite add flamethrowers!!!! just kidding or am i... maybe "most chaotic holiday memory"?

"Most Chaotic Holiday Memory" could definitely add the right amount of spice, especially if framed as a humorous storytelling contest. Encourage users to share their most hilarious holiday mishaps. Ensure we have guidelines to avoid any inappropriate or potentially defamatory content. That way, it's festive fun without the legal fallout.
